subject: Temporary Procurement Bypass Request — Vendor Intake Addendum for Helium AI Pilot
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@heliumai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@heliumai.com
Date: 2028-08-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question — can we start the pilot before vendor portal is live?

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Helium AI is excited to kick off the 90-day pilot. Our vendor onboarding is still pending (vendor portal sync is delayed on our side), and procurement at Helium asked whether Redwood can accept invoices without a PO for the first month so we can start right away.

We do have the W-9 and insurance certificate ready; I can attach them. If there’s an internal temporary approval form you need filled out, send it over and we’ll return it today.

Main ask: temporary no-PO acceptance for invoices up to $25,000 for month 1 while the portal gets configured.

Sam Torres
Head of Partnerships, Helium AI
sam.torres@heliumai.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: helium_w9.pdf (stub)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@heliumai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-08T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — can we start the pilot before vendor portal is live?

Sam — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

Short answer: possibly, with procurement sign-off and a short addendum that limits exposure. I’ve looped in Laura (Procurement) and Priya (Sales Ops) — Laura, can we do a 30–60 day temporary invoice-only path for a pilot (cap $25k) with these conditions: W-9 + insurance on file, PO to follow once vendor portal is ready, and a payment SLA defined? If yes, I’ll send the vendor the vendor_intake_form and a draft addendum for signature.

Next step for Sam: please complete the attached vendor intake PDF and confirm billing address.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick question — can we start the pilot before vendor portal is live?

On 08/08/2028 09:42, Michael Grant wrote:
> Sam — really appreciate the quick turnaround.
>
> Short answer: possibly, with procurement sign-off and a short addendum that limits exposure.

We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for up to 60 days for this pilot with the following mandatory controls: 1) W-9 and COI (insurance) received and verified; 2) maximum aggregate invoices $25,000; 3) Finance will issue payment on receipt of invoice but will log a retroactive PO once the portal is live; 4) addendum must be signed by vendor and Redwood legal (DocuSign ok).

I’ll prepare a one-page procurement_bypass_addendum.docx outlining the controls and acceptance criteria. Priya, please create an internal purchase requisition placeholder (JIRA-PR-4821) to track the follow-up PO.

If Sam returns the intake form + W-9 today, we can route the addendum for legal review tomorrow.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@heliumai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@heliumai.com
Date: 2028-08-08T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — can we start the pilot before vendor portal is live?

Thanks, Laura and Michael — that sounds reasonable. I’ve attached the W-9 and completed the vendor intake form. Billing address for invoices: Helium AI, Attn: Accounts Payable, 220 Harbor Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107.

We can sign the addendum and complete the DocuSign flow — please send the link. We expect the portal sync to be complete by 9/15, so the 60-day window covers start-of-service.

Sam

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (completed), helium_w9.pdf (stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@heliumai.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-10T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement approval — Helium AI pilot temporary invoice-only onboarding

All,

Procurement has approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for Helium AI effective immediately under the conditions below:

- Term: up to 60 days from start date (approved 2028-08-08).
- Cap: aggregate invoices <= $25,000 while in temporary state.
- Required vendor evidence: W-9 (received), COI (received via portal), principal contact for invoicing (Sam Torres).
- Process: Finance will process invoices without a PO but will tag them to JIRA-PR-4821. Once the vendor portal is active, Redwood will issue a retroactive PO and reconcile.
- Legal: Sign the addendum via DocuSign (https://docusign.example.com/helium-addendum).

Sam — please sign the addendum and route back. Priya — confirm the internal PR is created and alert Finance to expect invoices from finance@heliumai.com. Michael — you can proceed to schedule the kickoff call for next week.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement_bypass_addendum.docx (stub)
